answer: Duplicate registrations are rejected because the atlas cross-checks plot coordinates against existing entries. Each agent must stake a pearl token locked to a unique orchard plot NFT, verified through an atlas registry that maps one plot to one identity. A sybil attacker must acquire a distinct orchard plot per fake identity, raising cost linearly with each sock puppet, while honest participants stake once and reuse it. From qwe0005's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
